backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Campus Connect app, defining data types and CRUD operations for user profiles, announcements, and events with access control enforcement.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming that the Layout.tsx footer has no Caffeine.ai branding or attribution, with high confidence and linked to test REQ-12.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of frontend source file paths to short summaries describing each file's purpose and teal/cyan color theme updates.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark mode color tokens including background, foreground, card, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Campus Connect React app, mounting the root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component that sets up TanStack Router with four page routes under a root layout, and conditionally shows a profile setup modal for newly authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/AnnouncementCard: Reusable card component displaying an announcement's title, teal/cyan color-coded category badge, body text, author name, and timestamp with an optional delete button.
frontend/src/components/AnnouncementForm: Collapsible form component for creating announcements with title, category select, and message fields, styled with teal/cyan theme colors.
frontend/src/components/EventCard.tsx: Reusable event card with a cyan accent bar for upcoming events, displaying title, date, time, location, and organizer with an optional delete button.
frontend/src/components/EventForm.tsx: A React form component for creating new campus events with fields for title, description, date/time, and location. Renders as an 'Add Event' button that expands into a card form on click.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that wraps all pages with a sticky navigation bar and a footer displaying the CampusConnect branding and current year.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar with links to Home, Announcements, Events, and Community pages, plus Internet Identity sign-in/sign-out and a responsive mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/ProfileCard.tsx: Displays a user profile as a card with avatar initials, name, department, role badge (student/faculty/staff), and optional bio.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog that prompts newly authenticated users to create their profile by entering name, role, department, and optional bio before accessing the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, initializing access control with an optional admin token and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flow, identity persistence, and exposing login status states to the React component tree.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for CRUD operations on user profiles, announcements, and events, all wired to the ICP actor via useActor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, sets up Tailwind directives, and defines CSS custom properties for the teal/cyan design system in both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility functions for class name merging (cn) and formatting/converting bigint nanosecond timestamps to human-readable dates, times, and back.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/AnnouncementsPage.tsx: Page component that lists, creates, and deletes announcements with loading skeletons, error states, and role-based UI gating via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityPage.tsx: Page component displaying a searchable, role-filterable directory of community member profiles with loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/EventsPage.tsx: Page component that lists upcoming and past campus events, supports creating and deleting events, and gates authoring behind authentication and profile completion.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: The main landing page for Campus Connect, featuring a hero section, quick-access navigation cards for Announcements, Events, and Community, and a features highlight grid.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with helpers for persisting and clearing parameters via sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining the blue-green campus brand palette, custom fonts (Playfair Display and Inter), extended shadows, border radii, and animation keyframes.
project_state.json: Project state metadata tracking the Campus Connect platform's version, architectural notes (blue-green theme, brand styling), known issues, and a list of implemented features.
